maddeler.e:
تلاومت (form VI)
# تَلَاوَمْتُ (talāwamtu) /ta.laː.wam.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَلَاوَمَ (talāwama)
# تَلَاوَمْتَ (talāwamta) /ta.laː.wam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَلَاوَمَ (talāwama)
# تَلَاوَمْتِ (talāwamti) /ta.laː.wam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَلَاوَمَ (talāwama)
# تَلَاوَمَتْ (talāwamat) /ta.laː.wa.mat/: third-person fem
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
